Seat trim covers in fabric                                                                               •

4 steel wheels 8J x 18 in front, 8.5J x 18 in rear, Silver                                               •
Tool kit and Tire Mobility Set: 12-volt compressor and tire sealant                                      •
Tire pressure monitoring system                                                                          •
LOCKING SYSTEMS
Central locking system with Keyless Start, without SAFELOCK                                              •

Park Distance Control - warning signals for obstacles in the front and rear                              •
Cruise control system in combination with online services                                                •

Advanced driver attention & drowsiness monitor                                                           •
Autonomous Emergency Braking Front Assist with Pedestrian and Cyclist Monitoring                         •
eCall Emergency System                                                                                   •

Mobile phone interface                                                                                   •
Digital radio reception (DAB+)                                                                           •

LED headlamps                                                                                            •

Charging cable Mode 2 Type 2/G (10 A)                                                                    •
Charging cable mode 3 type 2, 16 A                                                                       •

5 year mechanical warranty or 100 000km whichever comes first                                            •
8-year or 160 000 km warranty whichever comes first, on high voltage battery                             •
12 year anticorrosion warranty                                                                           •
3 year paintwork warranty                                                                                •
